analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory (39.5→59.9) but remains in neutral zone, and MACD histogram is improving (-0.0005 → 0.0012) but not yet confirming a trend reversal. The 5-day low did not surpass the 20-day low, indicating a lack of upward momentum.
analysis.narrative:
[추세 위치]
· 현재가($0.18) vs SMA5/20/50($0.17/$0.17/$0.17) — 단기·중기 추세 중단 부근 위치
· SMA100/200($0.20/$0.24) 대비 하회 — 중장기 추세 약세
· 52주 위치(5.4%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 부근
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (39.5→59.9) — 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 진입, 상승 모멘텀 약함
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0005→0.0012) — 바닥 다지기 후 개선 시작, 추세 전환 신호는 아직
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $0.18) — 상단 밴드 터치, 밴드폭 13.14%로 변동성 보통
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($0.16) — 피벗(PP) 및 SMA50/EMA50 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.18) — 현재가와 일치, 돌파 시 상승 전환 기대
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (고가 $0.18 / 저가 $0.15) — 횡보 구간, Higher Low 미형성
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.14배) — 움직임에 힘 실리지 않음, 신뢰도 보통
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) — 5일 저가 유지하며 횡보, 0.18 돌파 시 매수 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.18) vs SMA5/20/50 ($0.17/$0.17/$0.17) — positioned near the middle of short-to-mid-term trends.
· Below SMA100/200 ($0.20/$0.24) — indicating weak mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (5.4%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.5→59.9) — exiting oversold into neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0005→0.0012) — bottoming out and starting to improve, but no trend reversal signal yet.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $0.18) — touching the upper band, with a band width of 13.14% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) — based on Pivot Point (PP) and SMA50/EMA50.
· Swing resistance ($0.18) — aligned with current price, potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (High $0.18 / Low $0.15) — sideways consolidation, no Higher Low formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.14x) — movement lacks strong conviction, moderate reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — holding 5-day low and consolidating, consider buying on breakout above $0.18.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가($0.15)가 20일 저가($0.15)를 하회하지 않고 유지되며 횡보하는 패턴. 0.18 저항선 돌파 여부가 중요.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The pattern shows consolidation, with the 5-day low ($0.15) holding above the 20-day low ($0.15). Breakout above the $0.18 resistance is key.
keyPoints: RSI 과매도 탈출 후 중립 구간 진입, 추가 상승 모멘텀 부족.
MACD 히스토그램 개선 중이나 추세 전환 확신 어렵고, 5일 저가 20일 저가 대비 상승 미확인.
0.18 저항선 돌파 시 매수 고려 가능하나, 현재는 횡보 구간으로 관망 유지.
keyPointsEn: RSI exiting oversold into neutral zone, lacking further upward momentum.
MACD histogram improving but trend reversal uncertain; 5-day low not confirmed higher than 20-day low.
Consider buying on $0.18 resistance breakout, but currently in consolidation phase, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see decision has been maintained for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI has moved out of oversold territory to 59.9 but remains in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram shows an improving trend. However, the 5-day low has not risen relative to the 20-day low, indicating insufficient upward momentum.
